method: tools/transcribe_scan.py: Internet Archive djvu.xml OCR, running heads and page numbers removed, paragraphs from the scan, words rejoined across line breaks, the space the printer set before punctuation closed, unique known-word OCR repairs recorded, unread words flagged and kept as printed. 48 misreadings corrected by hand against the page images of this scan, each listed in handFixes; no wording was taken from another edition. 214 words the vocabulary does not know (names, Latin, and foreign titles) were checked by hand against the page images and are listed in verifiedWords. A second OCR (tesseract 5.3.4, eng+lat) was run on the scan's page images and its reading taken for a line only where it read more words (129 of 2946 lines). Verse lines and stanza breaks are kept as printed on the verse leaves (20-131), and words are not rejoined there.
